title: Noa Kirel and Agustín Bernasconi Release Mírame Así Series Album
excerpt:
The stars of Prime Video's Mírame Así have released a ten-track companion album.
The record marks Noa Kirel's first Spanish-language album.
body_md:
Noa Kirel and Agustín Bernasconi have expanded the world of their musical romantic drama Mírame Así, El Camino de Noa with an album named after the series. Both performers are established recording artists as well as the show's leads, making the new release an extension of the story rather than an unrelated soundtrack promotion.

The 24-episode drama follows Noa, a young waitress who joins an emerging band after a painful breakup. The group is led by Tommy, played by Bernasconi. As Noa develops confidence in her musical abilities, she becomes entangled in a romantic triangle that tests her ambitions, loyalties and understanding of herself. Music is therefore central to the narrative's emotional stakes and to the character's development.

The series premiered on Prime Video across Latin America on October 9, 2026. It soon reached the second position in Argentina and entered top-ten rankings in other countries in the region, according to the reported performance figures. Those placements describe its early regional reception; they do not establish an equivalent ranking worldwide.

Released through FB Group, the album contains ten tracks, including nine original songs and one cover. Kirel and Bernasconi both contributed to the songwriting. It is also Kirel's first Spanish-language album, a notable step for an artist who finished third at the Eurovision Song Contest in 2023. Among the songs are Soñar Despiertos, Bye Bye Love and Mírame Así (Si Es Por Ti).

The connection between the cast and the music extends beyond the two leads. José Giménez Zapiola, who portrays Lalo in the series, joins them on Un Poco Más. His participation reinforces the album's identity as a creative companion to the show. No concert tour or separate live-performance schedule has been confirmed in the available announcement.

The drama was created by Argentine writer Patricia Maldonado, whose previous credits include Chiquititas and Rebelde Way. Filming took place in Argentina, where a television broadcast on América TV is also planned. The production brings together Sipur Studios, Yair Dori, Fam Contenidos and Swap, with Sipur handling international sales.

Another confirmed distribution step is a launch in Israel on Channel 16 on November 29, 2026. A comprehensive worldwide streaming rollout has not been announced. The album release and the expansion into another television market nevertheless show how the producers are developing the property beyond its initial Latin American streaming audience.
